    BulkOperationLifecycle.convergeAll(String namespace, BulkLifecycleAuditContext audit, BulkBatchProgressListener progressListener)
    Converges all eligible operations in namespace onto READY using at most one cold OpenAPI composition and one descriptor compilation: If the installed local snapshot and durable publication match the current release and all operations are already READY, skips with zero cold fetches. If the durable publication matches the composed digest, reconciles in-place (recording RECONCILE_ALL audit entries) or publishes only pending operations. If the durable publication is UNCOMPOSED, SUSPENDED, or on a previous release digest, suspends any stale generation atomically and publishes the new release within the same batch (recording PUBLISH_ALL audit entries).
